description.narrative: IFC is considering an up to US$50 million secured senior loan (IFC Financing) to Umai Group LLC (Umai), the largest retail chain operator in the Kyrgyz Republic (KR), and LogoPark LLC (LogoPark), a newly established project management company. Both entities are subsidiaries of Visor International DMCC and will be co-borrowers (companies). LogoPark will build a centralized distribution center (DC) to support the long-term growth of Umai in the next five to seven years. The IFC Financing will support Umais expansion plan up to 2029, which is expected to include 158 new stores, composed of supermarkets (3%), express grocery stores (18%) and proximity/convenience stores (79%). IFC Financing will be limited to (i) the construction of new retail stores, (US$38mn), and ii) a greenfield 26,000 sqm warehouse (US$33mn) which is in the planning stage (together, the Project).

The Project will increase consumer access to high-quality, affordable products, help modernize the Kyrgyz Republics grocery retail sector, drive efficiency gains in distribution, and enhance supply chain capacities.
